about_the_game:
You are a green alien of an unnamed species, embarking on a dangerous journey to reach the summit of the northern mountains — a rite of passage in your culture.

Armed with nothing but your wits, you must avoid threats lurking in every corner. Fortunately, mysterious power-ups and ancient devices are scattered throughout the land to aid you.

I like to describe the game as a new take on the maze genre — you are unarmed, and survival depends entirely on navigation, power-ups, and timing.

Each level consists of five areas, with the fifth area being a boss fight. Levels are accessed through a central world map, and new levels unlock as you complete previous ones.

As a personal initiative, I’ve decided to donate 25% of my earnings from this game to humanitarian relief efforts in Gaza, via the Danish Red Cross (Røde Kors Danmark). Read more here:

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-compatible GPU (e.g. GTX 750 Ti or Intel HD 530)
  • Storage: 425 MB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA or PulseAudio compatible sound card
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA or PulseAudio compatible sound card

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (2015 eller or newer) eller Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU (e.g. Intel Iris Pro 6200)
  • Storage: 425 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard audio hardware supported by macOS
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey
  • Processor: Apple M1 / M2 eller Intel Core i5 (2018 eller or newer)
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 560
  • Sound Card: Standard audio hardware supported by macOS
